audit.summary: The current paper still replaces the observational question marginal by equally weighted generated variants and replaces an evidence expectation by a union of evidence. Finite front-door models show these substitutions change the identified causal probability. This is Major damage to the claimed causal-adjustment interpretation, without establishing that the reported TableQA accuracy gains are false. Full mediation remains an explicitly unresolved modeling condition.
limitations: The current author repository is empty, so no implementation or historical prediction files could be inspected. No model, author program or old verifier was executed. The counterexamples concern causal identification, not the magnitude of benchmark effects. Figure/table population correspondence and training-data contamination remain unresolved without sample identities and run records.

proposition.claim:
Section 4.1 substitutes equal weights on jointly generated question variants for the observational marginal \(P(Q)\) in the front-door formula.

Section 4.2 substitutes a union of retrieved evidence for the outer front-door evidence average.

The depicted front-door graph has no direct Q-to-A path.

concern.description:
The current paper still replaces the observational question marginal by equally weighted generated variants and replaces an evidence expectation by a union of evidence. Finite front-door models show these substitutions change the identified causal probability. This is Major damage to the claimed causal-adjustment interpretation, without establishing that the reported TableQA accuracy gains are false. Impact assessment. Major is reserved here for the following supported core-claim or substantial derivation failure: Generated paraphrases do not identify the observational marginal; Evidence union changes the expectation target. Other local defects and unresolved candidates do not raise this assessment.

repair.content:
Use an identified observational marginal or justified importance weights \(P(Q)/g\) on common support. This does not identify the unknown proposal of an actual LLM.

Average conditional answer probabilities over the intended evidence mixture and its weights, rather than treating evidence union as that expectation.

State and justify mediation/support assumptions explicitly; the classical identification formula remains conditional on them.
